title: MiLoop: Selective Memory Propagation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.01685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constructive neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has emerged as a promising paradigm that learns to construct solutions to combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) step by step, which reduces reliance on handcrafted rules and enables fast inference. While many methods with dynamic embeddings generalize well, they typically rebuild subproblem representations from scratch at each step using deep attention stacks. Many high-performing methods in this category rely on solution labels or pseudo-labels for efficient training, or on aggressive search space pruning during reinforcement learning (RL). To address these limitations, we propose Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop), a purely RL-based constructive framework that leverages the multi-step computation already required by a rollout for selective memory propagation. translated_title: MiLoop：面向神经组合优化的选择性记忆传播
translated_abstract: 构造式神经组合优化（NCO）已成为一种有前景的范式，它通过学习逐步构建组合优化问题（COP）的解，减少了对手工规则的依赖并实现了快速推理。虽然许多采用动态嵌入的方法具有良好的泛化能力，但它们通常在每一步都使用深度注意力堆栈从头重建子问题表示。该类别中的许多高性能方法依赖于解标签或伪标签进行高效训练，或者在强化学习（RL）训练期间依赖激进的搜索空间剪枝。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了Memory-in-the-Loop（MiLoop），一个纯基于强化学习的构造式框架，它利用rollout本身已需要的多步计算来实现选择性记忆传播。每次rollout在传播历史表示的同时为学习提供解质量方面的反馈，从而实现……
tldr: MiLoop提出了一种纯强化学习的构造式神经组合优化框架，通过在rollout过程中选择性传播历史记忆表示，避免了每一步从头重建子问题表示的计算开销，同时摆脱了对解标签和激进搜索空间剪枝的依赖。
en_tdlr: MiLoop introduces a purely RL-based constructive neural combinatorial optimization framework that selectively propagates historical memory representations during rollouts, avoiding the costly rebuilding of subproblem representations at each step and eliminating reliance on solution labels or aggressive search-space pruning.
